name: Event / wedding venue
summary: Banquet/wedding venue: one large clear-span hall with a catering (warming or full) kitchen, bridal suites, restrooms, outdoor ceremony lawn/terrace and parking. Building cost tracks RSMeans social-club and country-club models; finish level (rustic barn vs. estate) and grounds drive the spread. Texas TDLR filings for new banquet halls (2022–24) show owner-estimated costs of ~$70–110/SF (one $417/SF outlier), well below RSMeans-based figures (~$235/SF in 2023 $ with sitework); the mid splits the difference and should be verified.

typicalSize.method: TDLR banquet halls: 11,669–20,918 SF (e5–e9). Typical independent wedding/event venues hold 150–400 guests seated; at ~25 gross SF per seated guest (hall ~12–15 SF/guest banquet plus kitchen, suites, restrooms, circulation) → ~4,000–10,000 SF; larger multi-room venues 15,000–20,000 SF. Derived.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Building SF per acre: event venues are low-FAR with lawn/ceremony grounds and parking (~0.4 spaces/guest). Derived.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per building SF: ~1 space per 2.5–3 guests at ~25 SF/guest ≈ 13 per 1,000 SF; assembly-use zoning commonly 1 per 3–4 seats. Derived.

perPrimaryUnit.method: 2023 dollars. Two evidence families disagree: (a) RSMeans 2019 building hard cost social club $157 union / $142 open shop (e1), community center $134 (e2), country club $205 (e3) → ≈ $175–$270 in 2023 dollars, ≈ $235 for social club incl. ~15% on-site work; (b) Texas TDLR owner-filed estimates for new banquet halls 2022–24: $69 (e6), $85 (e5), $96 (e9), $108 (e7) per SF, plus a $417 outlier (e8) — median ≈ $96, likely building-only and understated, and Texas is below national cost. Mid $180 ≈ midpoint of (a) ≈ $235 and (b) adjusted to national with sitework ≈ $120. Low $95 ≈ TDLR-type simple banquet box; high $400 ≈ estate/luxury venue (country-club finish) and the e8 outlier.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P and typical on-site work (parking, lawn/terrace, landscaping, utilities). Excludes land, soft costs, FF&E (tables, chairs, AV, decor), catering equipment beyond basic, off-sites, impact/tap fees.

qualityTiers.method: economy ≈ low/mid (95/180 = 0.53); luxury ≈ high/mid (400/180 = 2.2); premium interpolated.

systemSplit.method: Derived: assembly building with long-span roof (05/07), high finish share (09), catering kitchen (11, 22, 23), plus ~11% on-site work (31–33) consistent with the 1.18 sitework adder. Not taken from a published estimate; RSMeans model pages show totals only.

cost.method: Derived allowance: warming kitchen ~$50–100k; full-prep kitchen with Type I hood, walk-in, ranges/ovens, dish ~$150–350k.

lineItems.name: Outdoor ceremony site / pergola / terrace hardscape

cost.method: Derived: 2,000–5,000 SF terrace at $20–40/SF plus pergola/arbor (pergola costs per amenities block, Fixr) and lighting.
Finished residential-grade suites; ~country-club $/SF (e3, 2019 $205) with finish upgrade.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Banquet tables/chairs (~$100–200 per guest), AV/lighting, bar, decor; at ~25 SF per guest ≈ $8–16/SF plus AV. Derived.

pctOfHard.method: RSMeans models carry ~6–7.5% architectural fees (e1 page: architectural fees 7%); add civil/site, MEP engineering, permits, surveys, testing, legal, insurance → ~15–25%. Derived.

softCosts.notes: Rural venues may need septic/well studies and special-use permits (noise, assembly).

perPrimaryUnit.method: TDLR-type simple hall (~$95 hard, minimal soft) to luxury venue $400 × 1.3 incl. soft; 2023 dollars.

source.title: Club, Social - Commercial Construction Costs Per Square Foot (RSMeans model page)

evidence.quote: Club, Social with Decorative Concrete Block / Steel Joists ... SubTotal 100% $125.96 ... Contractor Fees (General Conditions,Overhead,Profit) 25% $31.49
evidence.scopeNotes: 2019 RSMeans national model, 22,000 SF, 1 story, union labor. value = subtotal + 25% contractor fees = $157.45/SF; open shop = $142.0/SF. Building only: excludes the architectural fees (6–8%) shown on the page, sitework, FF&E. Closest RSMeans model to a banquet/event hall.
